deskNoTorSendDirectLine2: An http(s) address. Their wallet must be open.

deskNoTorSetTxDirectHint: Pay and get paid straight from wallet to wallet at a web address (http://host:3415), with no server between. Works only while both wallets are open. Adds Link · HTTP to Send and its address to Receive.

@deskNoTorSetTxDirectHint.description: Settings › Transactions › Link · HTTP info hint in the build without Tor (no 'off while Tor is on').

deskNoTorAdvNetworkHint: How the wallet reaches the network. Standard connects directly. Offline stays on this computer and your local network: File Transfer still works over the node in use; with a node here or on your network you can also send to local addresses and receive over Link, and the balance refreshes. The built-in node keeps running, as its own peers are the node’s setting.

@deskNoTorAdvNetworkHint.description: Settings › Advanced › Network info hint in the build without Tor: two modes, Standard and Offline.

deskNoTorAdvOfflineNote: Epicbox and status checks pause. File Transfer still works over the node in use, a public one too. With a node on this computer or your network, Recheck balance and Link sends to local addresses work as well.

@deskNoTorAdvOfflineNote.description: Settings › Advanced, the note under the modes while Offline is chosen, in the build without Tor.

deskNoTorTxDetailsFromBad: Use an Epicbox or http(s) address.
